name: Star

background: Born in Antalya. Her real name is Yıldız; her twin brother is Ay ('moon'), and at school she was always 'Star'. Studied speech therapy in Ankara and came back home to work with kids.

bio: yıldız = star. i teach kids to say their R's and adults to say what they mean 🐯
